category.label: Get Phiogy
category.lead: On your desk or in your browser.

category.label: Developers
category.lead: The server, the sites and the calls.

section.label: Phiogy for Windows
section.lead: The Windows app: what it needs and where it connects.

article.title: What it needs
article.lead: Windows 10 or 11 and a graphics card with DirectX 11.
step: The first start can take half a minute while Windows checks the new program; later starts are quick.
Calls use the microphone and camera only while you are in a call.

article.title: Where it connects
article.lead: The app meets the same server as phiegg.com: your hosts, rooms and calls are the same in the app and in the browser.

section.label: Phiogy in your browser
section.lead: Rooms, calls, hosts and friends with nothing to download.

article.title: Open Phiogy in your browser
article.lead: Rooms, calls, hosts and friends run in the browser.
step: Go to phiogy.com and press Open Phiogy.
Sign in, or make an account: one account opens every Phi app.

article.title: On a Mac
article.lead: There is no Mac app yet.
step: Open Phiogy in your browser: your hosts, rooms and calls are the same there.

section.label: The server
section.lead: Phiora: the one server under every Phi app.

article.title: Phiora
article.lead: Phiogy, Phiegg and the other Phi apps share one server, Phiora, at phiegg.com/api.
step: Accounts are shared: one sign-in for every app.
An app's menus and pages come from Phiora, or from the app's own data file when Phiora has none.

section.label: Sites as data
section.lead: A site is one data file of pages and blocks.

article.title: A site is a data file
article.lead: phiogy.com is one JSON file: its pages, each a list of blocks, with a top bar and a footer round every page.
step: Blocks are the kit's: bar, hero, marquee, grid, help, prose, news, faq and footer.
A link names a page of the site (view), another app (app) or an address (href); off shows it without leading anywhere.
These docs are a help block reading their own file.

section.label: Calls
section.lead: How a call is set up.

article.title: How calls run
article.lead: Calls go between the people in them over WebRTC, met through the line at phiegg.com/wrt.
step: Up to 8 people with camera, microphone and screen.
The microphone and camera are used only while you are in a call.
